obligations.source_text: Create one independent complex fashion photograph that tests the gathered-waist, dropped-seat, voluminous-leg, and gathered-ankle structure of harem trousers while using the attached portrait only as an adult appearance reference.

bindings.gathered_waist_phrase: one gathered waistband releases substantial fabric into both trouser legs
bindings.roomy_seat_crotch_phrase: the seat and crotch remain visibly roomy beneath the waistband during her forward step
bindings.hip_thigh_volume_phrase: loose folds preserve pronounced volume through both hips and thighs
bindings.ankle_cuff_convergence_phrase: multiple folds converge separately into two narrow gathered ankle cuffs
bindings.harem_confound_phrase: the gathered cuffs distinguish the silhouette from straight wide legs and smooth balloon hems at both ankles
